payload.description: The atomic staging and per-target lock implementation at commit 50ee194 still waits indefinitely until the 15-minute timeout when a partial target exists without a live peer, when a lock is stale, or when a peer exits and releases its lock without publishing a target. Stale-lock detection currently does not perform stale-lock recovery. Correct the concurrency state machine so waiting is justified only by a live fresh lock, waiters re-evaluate when the lock disappears, stale locks are removed safely, abandoned staging directories cannot block progress, and incomplete legacy targets are repaired without racing an active owner. Add behavior-level process concurrency tests covering successful simultaneous materialization, peer failure, stale lock, partial target without a lock, and recovery without a 15-minute wait. Preserve staging validation and atomic publish.
payload.title: Recover stale or abandoned benchmark materialization state
